verdict.rationale: Omarchy's docs say it includes the Aether application for creating a new theme through a GUI where you can play with colors and search for backgrounds. Omarchy themes restyle the whole system: terminal, bar, notifications and wallpaper. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of Aether's workflow (how a created theme is saved and applied), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the GUI works as described.

support.subject: As a designer, I can create a custom system theme using a GUI color and background picker

citations.quote: You can also use the included Aether application to create a new theme using a lovely GUI interface to play with colors and search for backgrounds.
A theme restyles the whole system at once: terminal, bar, notifications, wallpaper.
You can find even more themes on the extra themes page or even make your own theme.
